The trust gap

A handshake is
not a credential.

Across Africa, skilled work runs on reputation. But that reputation lives in WhatsApp threads, old customers' memories and a list of names on a phone. The moment an artisan moves neighbourhoods — or a customer needs to trust someone new — it disappears.

VeriPass makes that invisible reputation visible, portable and checkable.

How VeriPass works

Six steps from
stranger to someone you can verify.

The artisan does the work. Didit checks identity. Real people confirm the record. VeriPass turns those signals into one clear level.

Mobile-firstUnder 10 minutesConsent-led
01

Build your profile

Trade, location, experience and availability. A simple, mobile-first record that works on any phone.

2 minutes
02

Verify your identity

A government ID, a liveness check and facial matching. Powered by Didit, never stored as loose photos.

Didit
03

Show your work

Add photographs and short descriptions of completed jobs. Evidence people can actually see.

Work evidence
04

Invite references

Clients, employers and fellow artisans get a private link to confirm the work they know about.

No account needed
05

Earn a level

Confirmed references build a clear verification level — from ID Verified to Work Confirmed to Trusted.

Transparent rules
06

Share your pass

Every artisan gets a unique code and QR. Anyone can check the record before hiring, in one scan.

Portable proof

The verification ladder

Trust you can read at a glance.

Every level has a rule. No mystery scores, no pay-to-win. Just identity, evidence and people willing to put their name behind the work.

Who you are
What you have done
Who vouches for you

Setup

Trusted

3+ positive references, including at least one from a fellow artisan.

Highest trust
06
Rejected

Identity verification or profile review was declined.

Restricted
07
Suspended

Account suspended by VeriPass operations pending review.

Restricted

For businesses & marketplaces

One API call.
A decision you can stand behind.

Stop asking for screenshots and phone numbers. Check identity and work history before an artisan joins your marketplace, enters a property or takes on a job.

  • Verify identity and level at onboarding
  • Display confirmed work evidence on listings
  • Flag suspended or rejected accounts before they transact
  • Integrate with a single read-only endpoint

VeriPass does not take bookings, process payments or compete for customers. It provides the trust layer other products build on.

GET

/api/verify/:code

Look up an artisan pass, verification level and trust signals.

POST

/api/references/:token/respond

Receive a confirmation from a client, employer or peer.

GET

/api/artisans/me

Issue and manage a verified artisan identity and work record.
